data.headline: Is Taiwan Semiconductor Stock a Buy Now?
data.summary: Up about 75% year to date as of this writing, Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing (NYSE: TSM), or TSMC for short, has been on a strong run this year as it has benefited from the AI infrastructure buildout.  TSMC is the world's leading semiconductor contract manufacturer, and produces chips for some of the largest tech companies in the world, including Apple and Nvidia.  Manufacturing chips is a capital-intensive business that requires building expensive foundries, and high utilization levels are necessary to ensure profits, which is why many of the world's top semiconductor companies outsource their chip manufacturing.
